admission.justification: The early clear spans the writer's marker and the plug-in's pending-only check, and prevents a written clear from waiting for the old deadline because no turn ends.

applicability: The plug-in's deferred provider-limit resumes and parent flushes while at least one is pending.
conditions: One stat-keyed snapshot of the limit file is read every 15 seconds, and only while a resume or flush is pending.
A seat's clear marker with no live limit in the same snapshot releases its pending action with the marker's clearedAt.
The natural deadline timer stays and re-arms when a later until appears.
exclusions: A read with no pending resume or flush.
A released parent that no longer owes a line.
A cleared seat that left the role record.
statement: One pending-only plug-in check observes written early clears and starts the existing resume and flush paths with the committed clear time.
